description: Defines nested classes and structs for BasicSourceLineResolver, including Function and Module classes, with methods for loading symbol data, address lookup, and frame info retrieval, used in source line resolution within the breakpad processor.

classes.name: BasicSourceLineResolver::Function
classes.description: Represents a function with a name, address, size, parameter size, and associated line information.

classes.name: BasicSourceLineResolver::Module
classes.description: Represents a module containing symbol data, with methods for loading data, address lookup, and retrieving frame info.

methods.name: LoadMapFromMemory
methods.description: Loads symbol map data from a memory buffer.

methods.name: IsCorrupt
methods.description: Checks if the symbol data is corrupt.

methods.name: LookupAddress
methods.description: Fills a StackFrame with information for a given address.

methods.name: FindWindowsFrameInfo
methods.description: Retrieves Windows frame info for a given stack frame.

methods.name: FindCFIFrameInfo
methods.description: Retrieves CFI frame info for a given stack frame.
